note: Hand-maintained. The app only reads this file. It does not fill vehicles from Launch Library 2. Add a source link for every vehicle you edit.

vehicles.name: Super Heavy Booster 7
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 1 on April 20, 2023. Lost during the ascent after engine failures and an FTS activation.

vehicles.name: Super Heavy Booster 9
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 2 on November 18, 2023. Lost after hot-staging, during the boostback burn.

vehicles.name: Super Heavy Booster 10
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 3 on March 14, 2024. Reached the landing burn and was lost about 400 m above the Gulf.

vehicles.name: Super Heavy Booster 11
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 4 on June 6, 2024. Controlled splashdown in the Gulf on a virtual tower.

vehicles.name: Super Heavy Booster 12
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 5 on October 13, 2024. First Super Heavy catch, by the launch tower at Pad 1.

vehicles.name: Super Heavy Booster 13
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 6 on November 19, 2024. Catch aborted after tower damage at liftoff. Controlled splashdown in the Gulf.

vehicles.name: Super Heavy Booster 14
vehicles.summary: Caught on Flight 7 (January 16, 2025). Lost on Flight 9 (May 27, 2025) before a Gulf splashdown.

vehicles.name: Super Heavy Booster 15
vehicles.summary: Caught on Flight 8 (March 6, 2025). Controlled Gulf splashdown on Flight 11 (October 13, 2025), the last Pad 1 flight.

vehicles.name: Super Heavy Booster 16
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 10 on August 26, 2025. Controlled splashdown in the Gulf.

vehicles.name: Super Heavy Booster 19
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 12 on May 22, 2026, the first Block 3 flight from Pad 2. Lost after an off-nominal boostback and a high-speed water impact.

vehicles.name: Super Heavy Booster 20
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 13 on July 24, 2026. Landing burn in the Gulf lit too few engines and the booster was lost.

vehicles.name: Super Heavy Booster 21
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 14 on September 28, 2026. Controlled splashdown in the Gulf after the first Starship orbital flight.

vehicles.name: Super Heavy Booster 22
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 15 on November 13, 2026. Boostback ended early on a low-fuel-mass alarm. The booster diverted offshore and the flight termination system fired after the landing burn.

vehicles.name: Ship 24
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 1 on April 20, 2023. Lost with the booster before stage separation.

vehicles.name: Ship 25
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 2 on November 18, 2023. Destroyed by the flight termination system after a fire and loss of communications.

vehicles.name: Ship 28
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 3 on March 14, 2024. Lost during reentry over the Indian Ocean.

vehicles.name: Ship 29
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 4 on June 6, 2024. Controlled splashdown in the Indian Ocean.

vehicles.name: Ship 30
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 5 on October 13, 2024. Controlled splashdown in the Indian Ocean.

vehicles.name: Ship 31
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 6 on November 19, 2024. In-space relight, then a daylight splashdown in the Indian Ocean.

vehicles.name: Ship 33
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 7 on January 16, 2025. Lost during ascent after a propellant leak. The booster was caught.

vehicles.name: Ship 34
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 8 on March 6, 2025. Lost during ascent. The booster was caught.

vehicles.name: Ship 35
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 9 on May 27, 2025. Reached engine cutoff, then lost control and broke up over the Indian Ocean.

vehicles.name: Ship 37
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 10 on August 26, 2025. Deployed simulators, relit in space, and splashed down in the Indian Ocean.

vehicles.name: Ship 38
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 11 on October 13, 2025. Last Block 2 ship. Controlled splashdown in the Indian Ocean.

vehicles.name: Ship 39
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 12 on May 22, 2026. Deployed simulators and two modified Starlink satellites, then a controlled Indian Ocean splashdown.

vehicles.name: Ship 40
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 13 on July 24, 2026. Deployed Starlink V3 satellites and splashed down in the Indian Ocean.

vehicles.name: Ship 41
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 14 on September 28, 2026. Reached orbit, deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites, and splashed down in the Pacific.

vehicles.name: Ship 42
vehicles.summary: Flew Flight 15 on November 13, 2026. Caught by the Pad 2 tower on November 14 after 14 orbits. First catch of a Starship upper stage.
